dataGovInFirstPass.result: No qualifying downloadable Indian building-footprint or cadastral parcel geometry was surfaced. Results inspected were a Bhuvan/NRSC/ISRO geoportal catalogue record with no listed result/resource on its page, GIS utility/public-facility location leads described as points, and administrative/statistical datasets.
dataGovInFirstPass.access: The Bhuvan OGD page opened and showed 'No Result Found'; opening the GIS group page returned a redirect-loop error in the web reader. Search result metadata was used only to reject non-polygon utility/location leads; no source bytes were obtained.

candidates.title: Bhuvan Geoportal of NRSC/ISRO (OGD catalogue record)
candidates.issuer: National Remote Sensing Centre / Indian Space Research Organisation, Department of Space
candidates.observed: The OGD page names NRSC/ISRO contributors and marks the catalogue entry as released under NDSAP, but the resource area displays 'No Result Found'. The page describes a geoportal, not a specific building or parcel vector layer.
candidates.terms: No resource-level layer or licence attachment could be evaluated because no source resource was listed.

candidates.title: KDMC_BASEMAP_24_04_2025 / Building FootPrint
candidates.issuer: Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation GIS service, hosted on maps.kdmc.gov.in
candidates.observed: Search-indexed ArcGIS metadata labels the service 'GIS CELL PREPARED THE BASEMAP' and lists a Building_Footprint group / Building FootPrint layer. The indexed metadata reports EPSG:32643 and JSON/GeoJSON query formats. The 2025 MapServer and 24_04_25 FeatureServer names are distinct service URLs; no assumption was made that their layer IDs or contents are interchangeable.
candidates.access: Opening the two indexed service roots returned HTTP 502 via the web reader. A bounded direct request to the 2025 FeatureServer/11 metadata URL returned no captured body or exit code. No feature query or geometry bytes were obtained.
candidates.terms: No resource-specific licence or use terms were located in this bounded pass; the indexed FeatureServer metadata showed no copyright text. Permission scope remains unconfirmed.

candidates.title: Bhunaksha_Folder/Bhunaksha MapServer
candidates.issuer: Telangana State Remote Sensing Applications Centre service host (tgrac.telangana.gov.in); underlying parcel-data publisher/lineage not stated on the service page
candidates.observed: The service page lists ULB cadastral layers, reports spatial reference 4326, and supports JSON/AMF query formats. Service Description is 't' and Copyright Text is blank. No layer feature query was made.
candidates.terms: The service page and indexed item metadata provide no usable source lineage/version or licence statement; permission scope remains unconfirmed.

existingSources.nwicDistrictBoundaries: Administrative boundary context only; not building footprints or cadastral parcels.
existingSources.gmdaAndReraContext: Previously recorded local context sources do not establish eligible building/parcel geometry or documented use permission; not requalified here.
existingSources.foreignCitySources: Existing NYC/3DBAG sources remain foreign and do not meet the Indian operational-source requirement.

qualificationGaps: No candidate supplied an accessible, bounded original vector response that could be retained byte-for-byte under the 16 MiB limit.
KDMC is the strongest official building-footprint lead, but the live service did not return metadata or feature bytes during this pass, and resource-specific reuse terms were not located.
The TGRAC service advertises cadastral layers, but its source lineage/version and licence scope are not stated in the available service metadata.
